answer:
The embeddings endpoint is `/api/embed`. The docs show it as a POST request with a JSON body containing `model` and `input`. The cURL example in the docs says:

"curl -X POST http://localhost:11434/api/embed \" [ollama/docs/capabilities/embeddings.md]

The request body is:

"\"model\": \"embeddinggemma\"," [ollama/docs/capabilities/embeddings.md]

"\"input\": \"The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.\"" [ollama/docs/capabilities/embeddings.md]

So `input` takes a single string. The docs also say you can pass an array of strings for a batch: "Pass an array of strings to `input`." [ollama/docs/capabilities/embeddings.md]

The API reference also lists an older endpoint, `/api/embeddings`, which takes a `prompt` field instead of `input`. Its example request is:

"\"prompt\": \"Here is an article about llamas...\"" [ollama/docs/api.md]

The context doesn't say whether the older endpoint is deprecated, so I can't tell you which one to prefer beyond what the current embeddings guide shows. The guide's examples use `/api/embed`, so that is the one to call.
